events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on this day in 1969, a pivotal moment in music and counterculture history.

angles.name: Summer of '69 Vibes
angles.copy: Imagine a field, half a million people, and three days of peace, love, and music. That's Woodstock, which kicked off on this day in '69. What a moment.

events.title: Elvis Presley Tribute
events.blurb: On this day in 1977, the world mourned the passing of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, at the age of 42.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Forty-nine years ago today, we lost the one and only Elvis Presley. His voice, his moves, his legacy – still unmatched.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
events.blurb: Guitar legend Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970, aged 27, leaving an indelible mark on music.

angles.name: Remembering Jimi's Genius
angles.copy: Today marks the anniversary of losing Jimi Hendrix in 1970. His innovative guitar work continues to inspire generations. What's your favourite track?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Crossing Abbey Road
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover, those tracks... pure genius.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Sending big birthday wishes to the incredible Chrissie Hynde, turning 75 today! Still rocking, still iconic.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Mad for it, Liam!
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still bringing that rock 'n' roll swagger.

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: The Click Wheel Revolution
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? Twenty-five years ago today, Apple dropped a device that changed our pockets and our playlists forever.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating the enduring legacy of 007 since 'Dr. No' premiered in '62. What's your favourite Bond moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: On this day, we remember John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Imagine... John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to resonate worldwide.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: And Now For Something Completely Different
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! A true titan of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: The White Album Turns 58
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles unleashed the iconic 'White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece of diverse sounds.

events.title: Freddie Mercury Tribute
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the world lost the extraordinary talent of Queen's frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Remembering a Champion
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, we said goodbye to the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain legendary.
